data.name: Kaahina
data.gender_notes: Kaahina is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root 'kh-n-y' meaning 'to sell' or 'to buy'. Kaahina is a name derived from the Quranic concept of buying or selling the good deeds in the hereafter. This name symbolizes the idea of investing in good actions for eternal rewards. The name Kaahina carries the meaning “Glorious, Pure” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kaahina usually hope their child will grow to embody glorious, pure and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Investing in good deeds for eternal rewards.
data.etymology: Kaahina belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Glorious, Pure.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kaahina total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

In certain regions, such as North Africa, it is a common name among Muslim women. According to some scholars, the name may have been influenced by ancient Berber cultures, where it was associated with the idea of haggling or negotiating, a skill that was highly valued in these communities.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic literature, the concept of selling or buying good deeds is recurrent. The Quran states, "Who is he that will lend to Allah a goodly loan so that we shall reward him with a multiplied reward?" (Al-Imran 3:152). This verse encourages believers to invest in their faith, to strive for good deeds and righteousness in their daily lives. The name Kaahina signifies this idea of investing in one's faith, and engaging in the pursuit of moral growth, self-improvement, and spiritual enrichment. Just as a wise buyer would carefully consider their purchases, a person with the name Kaahina is encouraged to weigh the value of their actions in the scale of their moral deeds. Each good deed is seen as an investment, one that will reap certain rewards in both this world and the next.
